about.text: A dry, salty cheese from the Bagaces area of Guanacaste in Costa Rica, dry-salted, pressed and smoked, and not ripened. It is used as a filling for tanelas.

links.name: 2024 International Dairy Journal paper on Bagaces cheese

sources.text: The salting, smoking and tanelas from the Costa Rican gastronomy article; the unripened, dry-salted cheese from the 2024 paper’s title.
